tools.name: inspect
tools.title: Inspect
tools.description: Read-only inspection of the current Blockbench project. `target` selects which slice of state to return; remaining fields are per-target filters. Replaces 28 legacy read tools (list_*/get_*/find_*/filter_*). See docs for the full target list. Returns structured JSON wrapped in { ok, data, meta }.

target.description: Which slice of Blockbench state to read. Each target accepts a subset of the optional filters below; unrelated filters are ignored.
target.markdownDescription: Which slice of Blockbench state to read. Each target accepts a subset of the optional filters below; unrelated filters are ignored.

tools.name: aj_blueprint_settings_get
tools.title: AJ: Get Blueprint Settings
tools.description: Returns all Animated Java Blueprint Settings for the active project as a JSON object (blueprint_id, export modes, TSB Optimized Export options, interpolation durations, etc.). Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project to be open. Use this before aj_blueprint_settings_set to discover valid keys and their value types.

tools.name: aj_blueprint_settings_set
tools.title: AJ: Set Blueprint Setting
tools.description: Sets a single Animated Java Blueprint Setting on the active project. Takes a `key` and a `value` whose type must match the setting's current type. Validates that the key exists and rejects type mismatches. Marks the project as having unsaved changes. Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project to be open.

key.description: Blueprint Setting key to update (e.g. `tsb_optimized_export`, `tsb_quantization_digits_default`, `interpolation_duration`). Call aj_blueprint_settings_get to discover valid keys and their current types.
key.markdownDescription: Blueprint Setting key to update (e.g. `tsb_optimized_export`, `tsb_quantization_digits_default`, `interpolation_duration`). Call aj_blueprint_settings_get to discover valid keys and their current types.

value.description: New value. Its type must match the existing value's type (boolean/number/string, or a number array for vector settings like render_box).
value.markdownDescription: New value. Its type must match the existing value's type (boolean/number/string, or a number array for vector settings like render_box).

tools.name: aj_rig_tree
tools.title: AJ: Rig Tree
tools.description: Returns the active Animated Java Blueprint's rig as a single hierarchical JSON tree, unifying regular bones (groups) and Armature bones — which Blockbench otherwise exposes through separate windows (list_outline vs list_armatures). Each node reports { name, uuid, type, children? } plus type-specific fields (armature bones add origin/rotation/length/connected; locators and null objects add position). Geometry (cubes/meshes) is omitted unless include_geometry is true. Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project to be open.

include_geometry.description: Include cube and mesh leaves under each bone. Defaults to false, returning a bone/locator/armature skeleton only.
include_geometry.markdownDescription: Include cube and mesh leaves under each bone. Defaults to false, returning a bone/locator/armature skeleton only.

tools.name: aj_variant_list
tools.title: AJ: List Variants
tools.description: Lists all variants of the active Animated Java Blueprint. Each entry reports uuid, name, display_name, is_default, selected, texture_map (source→replacement texture UUIDs), and excluded_nodes. Use this to discover variant identifiers for the other aj_variant_* tools.

tools.name: aj_variant_create
tools.title: AJ: Create Variant
tools.description: Creates a new (empty) variant with the given display name. The internal name and display name are made unique automatically. The new variant has no texture overrides yet — use the Blockbench UI or aj_variant_duplicate to populate its texture map. Marks the project unsaved.

display_name.description: Display name for the new variant. Made unique automatically if it collides.
display_name.markdownDescription: Display name for the new variant. Made unique automatically if it collides.

tools.name: aj_variant_duplicate
tools.title: AJ: Duplicate Variant
tools.description: Duplicates an existing variant (copying its texture map and excluded nodes) and selects the copy. Identify the source by UUID, name, or display name. Marks the project unsaved. Use aj_variant_update afterwards to rename the copy.

variant.description: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.
variant.markdownDescription: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.

tools.name: aj_variant_update
tools.title: AJ: Update Variant
tools.description: Renames a variant. Sets a new display_name (made unique) and regenerates the internal name to match. The default variant cannot be renamed. Marks the project unsaved. Note: the variants panel may need to be reopened to reflect the new name.

variant.description: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.
variant.markdownDescription: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.

display_name.description: New display name. The internal name is regenerated to match (made unique).
display_name.markdownDescription: New display name. The internal name is regenerated to match (made unique).

tools.name: aj_variant_delete
tools.title: AJ: Delete Variant
tools.description: Deletes a variant by UUID, name, or display name. The default variant cannot be deleted. If the deleted variant was selected, the default variant becomes selected. Marks the project unsaved.

variant.description: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.
variant.markdownDescription: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.

tools.name: aj_variant_apply
tools.title: AJ: Apply Variant
tools.description: Applies (selects) a variant by UUID, name, or display name so its texture overrides are shown in the editor viewport. This is the editor preview selection, not an export action.

variant.description: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.
variant.markdownDescription: Target variant: UUID, internal name, or display name.

tools.name: aj_export
tools.title: AJ: Export
tools.description: Exports the active Animated Java Blueprint using its configured export settings (data pack / resource pack paths and modes). This overwrites the existing output at those paths and may show progress or error dialogs in Blockbench. Returns whether the export completed. Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project to be open.

tools.name: aj_anim_id_mapping
tools.title: AJ: Animation ID Mapping
tools.description: Returns the animation id ↔ name mapping used by TSB Optimized Export. Each entry is { id, name, storage_name, loop_mode, length }, where id is the animation's index in the project's animation list (the value stored in the `<bp>.current_anim` scoreboard, with -1 meaning stopped) and storage_name is the sanitized name used as the storage path key. Useful for debugging exported datapacks. Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project to be open.

tools.name: aj_keyframe_set_easing
tools.title: AJ: Set Keyframe Easing
tools.description: Sets the named easing (e.g. easeInOutSine) on an animation's keyframes in bulk. Easing only applies to keyframes whose interpolation is 'linear'; non-linear keyframes are skipped and reported. Optionally narrow the target set by bone_name, channel, and/or keyframe_range; by default it covers every linear keyframe in the animation. Pass 'linear' to clear easing. Back/Elastic/Bounce/step easings accept easing_arg. Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project.

easing.description: Named easing function to apply to the keyframe `easing` field (e.g. easeInOutSine). Only affects keyframes whose interpolation is 'linear' — non-linear keyframes are skipped, mirroring the Animated Java panel. Use 'linear' to clear easing.
easing.markdownDescription: Named easing function to apply to the keyframe `easing` field (e.g. easeInOutSine). Only affects keyframes whose interpolation is 'linear' — non-linear keyframes are skipped, mirroring the Animated Java panel. Use 'linear' to clear easing.

easing_arg.description: Optional easing argument. Only used by Back/Elastic (overshoot), Bounce (bounciness) and step (number of steps). Defaults when omitted: Back/Elastic=1, Bounce=0.25, step=5. Ignored for easings that take no argument.
easing_arg.markdownDescription: Optional easing argument. Only used by Back/Elastic (overshoot), Bounce (bounciness) and step (number of steps). Defaults when omitted: Back/Elastic=1, Bounce=0.25, step=5. Ignored for easings that take no argument.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Restrict to this bone/group's keyframes. If omitted, applies across all bones in the animation.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Restrict to this bone/group's keyframes. If omitted, applies across all bones in the animation.

channel.description: Restrict to this channel (rotation/position/scale). If omitted, applies to all channels.
channel.markdownDescription: Restrict to this channel (rotation/position/scale). If omitted, applies to all channels.

keyframe_range.description: Restrict to keyframes within this time range (seconds, inclusive). If omitted, applies to all keyframes.
keyframe_range.markdownDescription: Restrict to keyframes within this time range (seconds, inclusive). If omitted, applies to all keyframes.

tools.name: aj_variant_op
tools.title: AJ: Variant Op
tools.description: Animated Java variant operations (create/duplicate/update/delete/apply) collapsed into a single tool. Specify `action` plus the relevant fields. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy aj_variant_create / aj_variant_duplicate / aj_variant_update / aj_variant_delete / aj_variant_apply.

action.description: Operation to perform. create: new empty variant. duplicate: copy an existing variant. update: rename. delete: remove. apply: select for the preview viewport.
action.markdownDescription: Operation to perform. create: new empty variant. duplicate: copy an existing variant. update: rename. delete: remove. apply: select for the preview viewport.

variant.description: Target variant for duplicate/update/delete/apply. UUID, internal name, or display name.
variant.markdownDescription: Target variant for duplicate/update/delete/apply. UUID, internal name, or display name.

display_name.description: Display name for create/update. Made unique automatically if it collides.
display_name.markdownDescription: Display name for create/update. Made unique automatically if it collides.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the most recent edit in the current project. Use `steps` to undo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were undone.

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the most recently undone edit. Use `steps` to redo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were redone.

tools.name: get_undo_stack
tools.title: Get Undo Stack
tools.description: Returns the current undo/redo history: the list of edit entries, the current index, and which entries are undone vs. applied. Use this to inspect available undo/redo operations and find named checkpoints.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (most recent first).
limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of entries to return (most recent first).

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.title: Save Checkpoint
tools.description: Inserts a named marker into the undo history. The marker can later be located with `get_undo_stack` so the agent knows how many times to call `undo` to return to this state. Does not modify the project.

name.description: Descriptive name for the checkpoint. Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.
name.markdownDescription: Descriptive name for the checkpoint. Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.

tools.name: history_op
tools.title: History Op
tools.description: Undo history operations (undo/redo/save_checkpoint) collapsed into a single tool. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy undo / redo / save_checkpoint. Inspect the stack with inspect(target='history').

action.description: Operation. undo/redo: traverse the Undo stack. save_checkpoint: insert a named marker. Use inspect(target='history') to list entries.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. undo/redo: traverse the Undo stack. save_checkpoint: insert a named marker. Use inspect(target='history') to list entries.

steps.description: Number of steps for undo/redo. Defaults to 1.
steps.markdownDescription: Number of steps for undo/redo. Defaults to 1.

name.description: Checkpoint name (action='save_checkpoint' only). Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.
name.markdownDescription: Checkpoint name (action='save_checkpoint' only). Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.

code.markdownDescription: JavaScript code to evaluate inside Blockbench. The last expression's value is returned. Promises are awaited.

read_only.description: If true, skip Undo.initEdit/finishEdit so no Undo history entry is created. Use this when the code only reads state.

resources.name: projects
resources.title: Blockbench Projects
resources.description: Returns information about available projects. List URIs use the slugified project name (e.g. `projects://my-character`) when unique, or `projects://<slug>~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: nodes
resources.title: Blockbench Nodes
resources.description: Returns the current 3D nodes in the editor. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `nodes://head`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Returns information about textures. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `textures://skin`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, slug, or short numeric texture id.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns reference models in the current project. Requires the Reference Models plugin. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `reference_models://turntable`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status including error/warning counts and a summary of all problems.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns all current validation warnings with element references where available.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns all current validation errors with element references where available.
